Perfect — we'll lock Thu 9/16 15:00 PT unless we hear otherwise.

Attached: Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.pdf and SOW-Draft-Acme-2026.docx (high-level, redline-ready). Highlights:
- We support hosted API initially; Dedicated (reserved capacity) is available if you need guaranteed throughput — we'll include cost delta in the SOW.
- For a pilot at ~500 concurrent sessions, our default recommendation is a Dedicated pool for predictable latency; Ethan can confirm sizing below.
- Typical procurement timeline: 1) SOW review (1–2 weeks) 2) PO/DocuSign (1 week) 3) Onboarding (2–4 weeks) depending on network/VPC work.

Agenda for the 60-minute kickoff (draft):
1) Introductions & goals (5)
2) Procurement & legal owners + SOW questions (15)
3) Security evidence & timeline (15)
4) SE: infra pre-reqs & sizing (15)
5) Next steps & owner / dates (10)

Ethan — can you confirm the sizing note and whether the network file Ramon should expect a checklist or a CSV? I'm attaching a minimal network-reqs.csv; feel free to update.

Priyom
-- Attachments: Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.pdf; SOW-Draft-Acme-2026.docx

Hi Natalie / team —

Quick technical notes ahead of the kickoff:
- For ~500 concurrent sessions we recommend starting with a 4-GPU Dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100 class) to meet low-latency SLAs; if cost is a concern we can run a hosted pilot and measure token throughput, then convert to Dedicated.
- Please have Ramon or CloudOps confirm whether outbound IP allowlist or VPC peering is preferred. For VPC peering we'll need CIDR ranges and a contact for the peering request.
- I've attached network-reqs.csv with the fields we typically require (peering, firewall rules, expected egress, ports).

If Ramon can reply with the CIDR ranges and whether DocuSign outbound endpoints need to be allowed, that will speed onboarding.

Ethan Park

ethan.park@redwood.com

Hi Priyom —

Procurement here. A few items before the kickoff:
- Please provide a one-page commercial summary (term, list price, setup fees, any onboarding credit).
- We prefer DocuSign for execution; include the DocuSign path in the SOW so we can route internally.
- Timeline expectations: we typically allow 2 weeks for legal review + 1 week for approvals; if there are material redlines we may need additional time.

Also confirm whether Redwood needs a PO or if DocuSign alone is sufficient. If you have a reference for other enterprise customers that used Dedicated capacity, sharing a brief case note is helpful.

Thanks,
